info.name: Google Cloud Dataflow API
Jobs
Google Cloud Dataflow List aggregated jobs across all regions

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the job.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A token identifying the page of results to return. Set this to the nextPageToken value returned by a previous list request.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per page. If unspecified, the server will determine the number of results to return.

params.name: view
params.description: The level of detail to return for each job. Defaults to JOB_VIEW_SUMMARY.

params.name: filter
params.description: The kind of filter to use for listing jobs.

params.name: name
params.description: Optional. The job name to filter results.

items.docs: Lists all Dataflow jobs associated with the specified project across all regions. Returns a paginated list of jobs including their current state, type, and metadata.

info.name: Google Cloud Dataflow List jobs in a project

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the job.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A token identifying the page of results to return. Set this to the nextPageToken value returned by a previous list request.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per page. If unspecified, the server will determine the number of results to return.

params.name: view
params.description: The level of detail to return for each job. Defaults to JOB_VIEW_SUMMARY.

params.name: filter
params.description: The kind of filter to use for listing jobs.

params.name: name
params.description: Optional. The job name to filter results.

params.name: location
params.description: The regional endpoint for the request, such as us-central1 or europe-west1.

items.docs: Lists all Dataflow jobs associated with the specified project. Returns a paginated list that can be filtered by state and name. Use the location- specific endpoint for regional job listing.

info.name: Google Cloud Dataflow Create a Dataflow job in a project

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the job.

params.name: view
params.description: The level of detail to return for each job. Defaults to JOB_VIEW_SUMMARY.

params.name: replaceJobId
params.description: Deprecated. The ID of the job to replace when updating a pipeline.

params.name: location
params.description: The regional endpoint for the request, such as us-central1 or europe-west1.

items.docs: Creates a new Dataflow job in the specified project. The job definition includes the pipeline configuration, environment settings, and execution parameters for batch or streaming workloads.

info.name: Google Cloud Dataflow Get a Dataflow job in a project

params.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the job.

params.name: jobId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Dataflow job.

params.description: The regional endpoint for the request, such as us-central1 or europe-west1.

items.docs: Retrieves the state of a specified Dataflow job in the given project. Returns the full job resource including current state, pipeline description, environment, and metadata.

info.name: Google Cloud Dataflow Update a Dataflow job in a project

params.name: projectId
params.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the job.

params.name: jobId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Dataflow job.

params.name: location
params.description: The regional endpoint for the request, such as us-central1 or europe-west1.

params.name: updateMask
params.description: The list of fields to update relative to the job. If empty, only the requestedState field will be considered.

items.docs: Updates the state of an existing Dataflow job in the specified project. This is primarily used to change the requested state of a job, such as cancelling or draining a running job.

info.name: Google Cloud Dataflow Get template metadata in a specific location

params.name: location
params.description: The regional endpoint where the job resides, such as us-central1 or europe-west1.

params.name: gcsPath
params.description: Required. A Cloud Storage path to the template from which to create the job. Must be a valid Cloud Storage URL beginning with gs://.

params.name: view
params.description: The view to retrieve. Defaults to METADATA_ONLY.

items.docs: Retrieves the metadata for a Dataflow template in the specified project and regional location. Returns template information including name, description, parameters, and streaming capability.

params.name: validateOnly
params.description: If true, the request is validated but not actually executed. Defaults to false.

params.name: dynamicTemplate.gcsPath
params.description: Path to the dynamic template spec file on Cloud Storage.

params.name: dynamicTemplate.stagingLocation
params.description: Cloud Storage path for staging dependencies.
